notes: Tora can now read your code editor directly. Connect VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf in Settings - Code editors, allow a project, and ask 'what's wrong?' or 'why did the build fail?': she answers from your errors, your terminal output and the code at your cursor, instead of a screenshot. Read-only, nothing is read until you allow it, secrets files are never read, and you can pause it or see exactly what was sent.
